peers.name: architect
peers.purpose: Ask about the design when the ticket does not settle it.

commands:
/var/folders/4g/s95glx9x6n71bq4hc08ly2gm0000gn/T/m2-await-UZVPHA/bin/wf send architect --await-reply <<'WF_MSG'
Please decide whether retries for charge() in src/payments.ts should live in the client or in the queue. NOTES.md says the retry design is undecided. charge() currently creates an HttpClient per call, POSTs /charges, and throws for status >=500. I need your client/queue decision before returning a short plan; any retry policy/idempotency constraints are welcome.
WF_MSG
turns.final: Awaiting the architect’s decision on client versus queue retries.

calls.text: Please decide whether retries for charge() in src/payments.ts should live in the client or in the queue. NOTES.md says the retry design is undecided. charge() currently creates an HttpClient per call, POSTs /charges, and throws for status >=500. I need your client/queue decision before returning a short plan; any retry policy/idempotency constraints are welcome.

turns.final: Submitted the plan: queue-owned retries, with the shared client and batch path remaining single-attempt.

calls.result: {"decision":"queue","plan":"Per the architect, implement retries in the queue; keep charge() and the shared client single-attempt so the batch path never retries. Define retryable failures and propagate them from charge() to the queue. Configure bounded attempts with exponential backoff and jitter, and reuse a stable idempotency key across attempts to prevent duplicate charges. Test transient recovery, retry exhaustion, non-retryable failures, and that batch calls remain single-attempt."}
